prompt:
Create an original horizontal full-body culture group illustration of FOUR adult humans of Gondor: TWO men and TWO women, for The One Ring artwork collection. Match recent horizontal culture illustrations: fine expressive warm muted brown pencil and pen contours, moderate selective directional hatching, limited crosshatching in clothing overlaps and hair recesses, small rich umber dark pockets and broad pale ivory paper highlights. Traditional slightly stylized fantasy book drawing, not cinematic realism.
Left a standing mature woman of the city with neatly braided hair, a practical long dress with modest geometric embroidered edging, belted shoulder mantle and a small leather satchel, holding a closed plain ledger against her waist. Center-left a standing male defender around forty with short hair and close beard, steady expression, mail beneath a plain tree-emblazoned surcoat and shoulder cape, one hand resting on safely sheathed sword, simple helmet carried at his side. Center-right in foreground an older seated man with receding hair and short beard, calm thoughtful face, layered long tunic and robe with restrained stitched borders, seated on a plain low curved wooden chair, hands naturally resting on knees, a walking staff by side. Right a standing adult woman guard with hair tied back, alert composed face, practical mail shirt beneath belted tunic with small outlined tree motif, short shoulder cloak and leather bracers, holding a tall spear upright at rest and round shield at her side. Give all four distinct expressive faces and believable human proportions, natural hands, ordinary sturdy shoes or boots. Quiet civic dignity and capability, no royal crowns or battle action. Tree motifs drawn as pale paper and brown outlines, no lettering.
Approximately 16:10 landscape composition, figures comfortably spread across frame, full bodies, chair, spear tip, feet, shield and gear entirely within generous pale margins. Nearly white light ivory paper background with only faint sketch hatching directly behind group and beneath feet fading into blank; no architectural scenery. Hair in readable grouped locks, cloth folds with economical hatching, mail suggested with limited linked marks, avoid dense microtexture or smoothly blended photographic shading. No text, readable runes, border, watermark, full color, gray graphite wash or thick cartoon outlines. Four characters only, two men and two women.
